speaker: Samantha
text: During training, to simulate weightlessness, astronauts have to wear suits that weigh 160 kg and stay underwater for about four hours. They lose an average of 2 kg during each training session, and after a session they would be too exhausted to hold chopsticks. When conducting centrifuge training, astronauts must endure a force as much as eight times their own weight so that they will be able to resist the g-forces that severely restrict the ability to breathe during lift-off. None of the astronauts has pressed the emergency button to halt the program.
